problem: The Caster Level box prints 1, 2 and 3 for a Bloodrager at levels 1-3. The engine's own chassis says caster level 0 below level 4, so the desktop tab disagrees with the engine for a roster class.
evidence: f6a-class-facts-wire.json class:bloodrager L1 = {caster, 1, advanced_class_guide:class:bloodrager#bonus4}. The engine's class_census --sheet-dump bloodrager:1 and bloodrager:3 give class_chassis.bloodrager.caster_level value=0 ('rule does not open until Bloodrager level 4'). The converted rule's applies is ClassLevel(bloodrager) >= 4 (acg_classes.lst:44, PRECLASS:1,Bloodrager=4). class_caster_level_in calls evaluate() and never checks rule.applies, and held_set pulls in principal siblings without gating them. Cross-check over 59 roster classes x levels {1,7}: 37 agree, 80 have no engine line to compare, 1 contradicts (merge-readiness/caster-level-desktop-vs-engine-59.txt). Model probe: merge-readiness/probe12.jsonl.
fix: Gate each held CasterLevel rule with evaluate_applies(&rule.applies, ...), and treat a closed gate as 'no caster level yet'. Re-pin f6a-class-facts-wire.json. Add bloodrager 1/3/4 to every_roster_class_answer_is_counted.

problem: The row is red: forbidden string 'failure'. It reproduced on the full run and on an isolated rerun.
evidence: The Smoke Test PC (Elf Wizard 1, with the create path's fixed Chain Shirt) prints the Chain Shirt StatBlock 'Arcane spell failure: 20%' in the Actions tab's Rules and features section. That is correct PF1 text, so this is a false positive of the harness's global forbid. The row was last green in the 2026-09-18 full run; no full run happened since, and F6 did not cause it. Evidence: merge-readiness/ui-smoke-full.log:56, ui-smoke-rerun.log, sheet-tab-actions.FAILED.png.
fix: Add allowGlobalForbid: ["failure"] to the row with the reason in its notes, the same exemption F6c gave sheet-f6c-shaman-no-domain-line. Then rerun the row.

problem: The row is red because the Intelligent Item Components screen shows '0 components' and 'All books (0)'. The app serves 0 of 246 records.
evidence: intelligent_item_catalog::load_record_rows reads data.key from data/corpus/<book>/equipment/equipmods/*.json. codex_repo_root() resolves to the resource dir, whose generated corpus bundle writes every equipment file as '{}' (scripts/gen-corpus-bundle.mjs transform('equipment')). The Intelligent Item records are core_rulebook 161 + mythic_adventures 85. This affects the dev app and packaged builds. It is pre-existing: the bundler commit b1e3b2fa4a (2026-09-20) came after the last full green run, and F6 touched none of those files. It reproduced on 2 runs. Evidence: merge-readiness/intelligent-item-catalog-open-and-search.FAILED.png.
fix: Choose one: bundle the fields this catalog reads (with a residue audit), or read the components from the converted package or the _settled bundle that already ships.
